note: Cases cover the contrast rule: body and large text ratios, an on pairing, a plate backing, control strokes with and without a fill that reaches 3:1, the 13px floor, controls (a material look, a look without textColor, none and transparent colours), a translucent backdrop, base merged under the style looks, the dark variant path and a style with no readable palette. Severity is error except translucent and theme-unread, which are warnings.
